title: Update README and Phase 2 technical decision documentation
acceptance_criteria: README replaces the starter-template framing with project-specific setup, scripts, feature overview, local persistence behavior, and offline/PWA usage instructions.
README documents that browser reminders are best-effort, permission-gated, and have an unsupported fallback; it does not promise reliable iPhone notifications.
A technical decision document records why the PoC remains local-only, how storage versioning/migration protects existing data, and the service-worker cache/update strategy.
Documentation identifies known limitations, including no backend/account sync and no guaranteed background scheduling.
Documentation examples and commands match the final package scripts and all prose is in English.
